Question: To complaint about the sewer overflow on the road. (Sewer overflow ho raha hai, sadak pe behta hai
Answer: Sewerage/Drainage Department — this is usually treated as a priority/health-hazard complaint. Mention if it's near a school, market, or residential cluster, as that affects prioritization.

Question: During the rainy season, water logging happens in our street every year. (Barsaat mein humari gali mein paani bhar jata hai har saal
Answer: This is a drainage/waterlogging complaint — different desk from routine sewer blockage since it often needs monsoon-season desilting work planned in advance. Best filed before monsoon (April–May) as a preventive request, not just after flooding happens.
